CLAUSE_ANALYSIS.LEASE_BINDING: [121] binds mission generation, membership epoch/record generation, task version, spec hash, resource graph hash, engineering epoch, and lease generation. It does not bind Mission Fence STATE_VERSION, stop state, or admission gates.
CLAUSE_ANALYSIS.STALENESS: [122] allows a binding change to stale a lease, but USER_STOP is not required to change any [121] binding.
CLAUSE_ANALYSIS.STOP_INVARIANT: [164] requires USER_STOP to be immediate and preemptive; [166] requires Mission Fence CAS after fence creation.
CLAUSE_ANALYSIS.WORK_LOOP: [220] checks USER_STOP and later revalidates a fixed list before IMPLEMENT, but the listed revalidation does not include STOPPING/STOPPED, WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE, or Mission Fence STATE_VERSION.
CLAUSE_ANALYSIS.TERMINATION: [230] makes USER_STOP terminal at mission level.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_REPRODUCTION: Worker W holds a lease valid under every binding explicitly listed in [121].
W reads canonical state and completes the [220] revalidation while USER_STOP is absent.
USER_STOP then linearizes through Mission Fence CAS before W performs the product-branch write.
If STOP CAS closes gates/state only, without changing ENGINEERING_EPOCH or MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, every explicit [121] lease binding still matches.
Because [220] does not require an atomic final STOP/gate check at the write boundary, the procedural text alone does not force W to observe the intervening STOP before writing.
QUALIFICATION: The semantic invariant in [164] means any actual post-STOP product mutation would be noncompliant.
A robust implementation may voluntarily prevent the race by incrementing a bound epoch on STOP or performing an atomic final mutation-admission check.

However V16-RC1.3 does not currently require one specific synchronization mechanism, so activation cannot prove that all compliant protocol realizations enforce the [164] invariant at the mutation linearization point.
REQUIRED_RESOLUTION: Canonically require STOP entry to invalidate all mutation authority before STOP becomes effective, for example by atomically incrementing ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH while closing gates; or
Bind a monotonic stop/fence generation to leases and final mutation admission; or
Require an atomic final Mission Fence/gate check at the product-write linearization boundary.
Define crash/race semantics and independently verify the chosen rule prevents any mutation commit after the authoritative USER_STOP linearization point.
RESOLUTION_AUTHORITY_NOTE: This can be implemented as an authoritative operational interpretation/repair only if it is demonstrably consistent with the Constitution and does not silently weaken or alter [164]. Otherwise a law activation/change is required.
